shootingPool.source: Existing OffMapBench/static shooting import (original annotated pairs, not raw RT events)
shootingPool.splitScope: Task ID and byte-identical held-out image disjointness. Not video/scene-level separation. Labels retain their original silver quality; no new human annotation.

provenance.scope: Training-only opt-in. Same city/scene assets are reused; no global train/evaluation spatial split is claimed.

retained.exception: Preserved 90.37m example replaces one nominal 100m/2-turn/no-landmark slot.

allocation.rounding: largest remainder; higher source weight then seeded tie break
allocation.scope: joint route length (rounded to 0.01 m) and effective >=35 degree bends; optional endpoint GLB types sampled independently; does not copy source mission interactions or assets at the start
